entries.speaker: Haru

entries.en: ...He's right. That was the[n]same thought I had.

entries.en: I agree!

You don't have to do this.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, then... do you think[n]you could help me out again[n]sometime? Like you did today.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hey, um... do you think you[n]could help me out again[n]sometime? Like you did today.
